title: Ring of Regeneration
summary: Heals 1d4 HP at the start of your turn in combat.

fields.Combat Regeneration: While in combat, heal 1d4 HP at the start of your turn, even at full health. Does not trigger while Downed. Can trigger eligible on-heal gear such as The Whispering Promise.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Rolan or Lorroakan’s Projection at Sorcerous Sundries, or look for it on Rolan in Ramazith’s Tower immediately after Lorroakan dies.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
